webhook_enabled.description: Enabling future webhook execution requires both local grants, including creation.

oneOf.description: Explicitly clear the Server association. Clone/pull then remain unavailable.

field.description: The exact structured reference Core may detach, or may leave dangling.

apply_resource_sync.output/RepoEffects.description: The receipt discloses which saved hooks can execute, never their source.

oneOf.description: Core reported Complete. Use latest_update.outcome for success or failure.

latest_update.description: Preserved across a later timeout, cancellation or read failure.

observation_error.description: A gap in local observation, not evidence of remote execution failure.

oneOf.description: Complete trusted desired-state TOML. Omitted desired fields can reset defaults.
Omitted options preserve their saved values; creation requires resource_paths.
Core-host paths under sync_directory / normalized sync name, never MCP-host paths.

match_tags.description: [] deliberately removes the resource-tag restriction. Variables/groups are separate.

webhook_enabled.description: Creation explicitly defaults false. Enabling requires both startup grants.

webhook_secret.description: Original secret only; "" restores Core's default secret. Never returned.

address.description: Empty selects Periphery-to-Core connections. Never contains credentials.

oneOf.description: Replace managed inline Compose content; never writes a host/Git file.
Set the Git repo; omitted Git options preserve existing values.
Select existing host files. This never writes their contents.

apply_stack_create.input/StackPatch.description:
Omission preserves a field; null is invalid. Empty environment and an empty
ignore list explicitly clear those fields. Boolean values cannot be cleared.

environment.description: Secret-bearing Compose environment. Returned only as a redacted change.

project_name.description: Empty string restores Core's default Stack-name project selection.

source.description:
Applying a supplied source needs both local operate and configuration-edit
grants, regardless of Core's current auto_update policy. Creation is separate.

oneOf.description: Always creates is_secret=false; no secret provisioning or classification field.
The only supported secret-entry mutation. Omitted values remain private.

value.description:
Only get_variable and change previews include an ordinary value that passes
the documented projection; secret fields are absent, never masked text.

cancel_action.output/CancellationResult.description:
Reused across resource-specific cancellation APIs. The cancellation's own
receipt and the original update are independent observations, never rollback.

active_update_id.description:
For update targeting, this describes only the checked original ID, not
an exhaustive list of simultaneous runs.

oneOf.description: One exact Compose service. No wildcard, array, or display-name matching.

running_tasks.description: Docker often supplies this only on the cached list, not fresh inspect.

failure_reason.description: Conservative application-owned classification; never raw Docker errors.

replica_evidence.description:
current = desired running; historical = desired shutdown/remove;
unknown = Core did not establish either. Not a healthy-replica count.

attempts.description: Counts of create, command and delete attempts.

cleanup.description: Owned cleanup state with the observed reason or evidence of absence.

target.description: The resolved Core terminal target, identifying one server or container.

authoritative_apply_input.description: Always false: omission/default resets make this inspection-only output.

selection_complete.description: True only when Core returned every explicitly selected resource/group.

gaps.description: Failed inventory families are recorded here; successful families survive.

has_more.description: True if any family filled its page. Continue to establish exhaustion.

state.description:
Inventory state, replaced by GetServerState when that read succeeds.
`health` and `gaps` disclose whether the current check was available.

refresh_ts.description: Core's cache refresh timestamp in milliseconds, not the time of this call.

server_id.description: A Swarm association takes precedence over a Server association.

service_count.description: Expected distinct Stack service names from inventory; None for Deployments.

id.description: Server ID for a container, otherwise the workload's stable ID.

bytes.description: Redacted selected lines exceeded the joint UTF-8 byte budget.

lines.description: More than the requested joint line limit was returned by Core.

upstream_may_have_more.description: Core provides no complete-log count. A full tail may omit earlier logs.

image.description:
Core's cached image, which can fall back to desired configuration when
runtime cache data is missing. This does not verify the running image.

name.description: Null if Core did not supply a display name. The ID remains usable.

id.description: Full image sha256: digest or full local/Swarm network ID. Volumes use exact name only.

name.description: Exact image reference or network/volume name; no prefixes, credentials or wildcards.

observed_cloned_revision.description: Current Core/Periphery cache, not proof of a particular execution's result.

project_name.description: Deployed project name, then configured project name, then resource name.

service_count.description: Count of services reported by Core, not a count of running containers.

name.description: Docker volumes have names, not stable immutable object IDs in Core lists.

next_page.description: Null if the lookahead observed exhaustion; this is not a snapshot token.

variant.description: Alert variant only; raw variant payloads, messages and error chains are omitted.

page_size.description: Core's fixed maximum records per page.

original_submission.description:
History without a known acknowledgement cannot identify this invocation,
even when there is only one matching update or the same Core actor.

oneOf.description: Core's whole-workload operation variant matches; no attribution proof.
A bounded requested-service log matches; no invocation or isolation proof.
Missing/ambiguous Core service log, inaccessible detail or lookup cap.

max_output_bytes.description: Serialized structured-report JSON bytes; text content and MCP framing add overhead.

max_wait_ms.description: Two bounded waves; includes inventory resolution in its first deadline.

affected_services.description: At most four affected service names; services retains further evidence.

truncated.description: At least one service was omitted. A truncated healthy set is inconclusive.
